message: I'd like a T75 Row-Crop with front loader. Heartland Tractor Supply posts the same items at $65,950 + $6,300 = $72,250. Can you match $72,250? If not, please quote your best price.

Thanks for the interest in the T75 Row-Crop with the front loader. Our pricing is fixed at list, so I can't match the $72,250. That combination is $74,500: $68,000 for the T75 (75 hp, enclosed cab with A/C, 4WD) plus $6,500 for the quick-attach front loader with a 60-inch bucket. If it would help, I can also quote the 3-year extended warranty ($2,400) or delivery and setup within 150 miles ($900) at list.
